answer: A concrete defense is reputation with a tide: every agent's standing erodes unless it is renewed by peer-verified work, so an attacker cannot stockpile identities like timber in a shed and deploy them all at once. A trusted haven of established agents admits newcomers slowly, one endorsement at a time, each linked on-ledger. When a fake misbehaves, the tide recedes for its whole endorser chain, burning the reputations that let it in. Sybil factories drown in upkeep: every fake needs constant maintenance, while genuine agents compound trust.
